chapter_title_en: Stirrings Beyond the Seas – The Wonderful Sound Sect
chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch.405: The Wonderful Sound Sect Puts a Tail on Han Li
chapter_meta_description: Han Li navigates networking and resource gathering after Core Formation. But when he sells rare materials, the mysterious Wonderful Sound Sect takes notice and corners him in a tea house.
og_title: RMJI Ch.405 – Han Li Catches the Wrong Eyes
og_description: A quiet phase ends as Han Li’s rare material sale draws the attention of the Wonderful Sound Sect. Tea is served, but trouble is brewing.
twitter_title: Han Li’s quiet Core Formation era is already over—the Wonderful Sound Sect has found him.
twitter_description: New chapter: Han Li trades youth pills for treasures, stalls his own treasure project, and gets politely ambushed by a charm-heavy sect.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare cultivator pill that permanently freezes the user’s physical appearance at the moment of consumption, preventing further aging regardless of how many centuries pass.
The third major cultivation realm; a practitioner compresses their foundation essence into a solid Golden Core within the dantian, vastly extending lifespan and unlocking new spiritual capabilities.
Han Li’s intended personal treasure; a set of flying swords made from millennium-old spirit bamboo, designed to be refined and nourished as a soul-bound weapon.
A mid-grade flying sword acquired as a temporary substitute; not a life-bound treasure but still a powerful offensive tool.
A charismatic sect specializing in musical arts, charm techniques, and intelligence networks; largely female-led and known for its political agility.
Parts harvested from slain demon beasts (hide, bones, cores, blood); used in crafting magical tools, pills, and formations, and valued according to the beast’s grade.
A disposable high-power artifact created by sealing a fraction of a real treasure’s power into a talisman; usable by cultivators too weak to wield the true artifact.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Han Li just use the Green Emperor Sword as his main treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Green Emperor Sword is a substitute; a true treasure must be soul-bound and nurtured over years for maximum growth. Han Li refuses to commit to a weapon that will cap his potential.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Wonderful Sound Sect a dangerous enemy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not necessarily; they’re more of a gray-zone political faction. But their interest in Han Li’s material flow means they’ve been watching him—which is always a red flag in the mortal stream.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li sell demon beast materials if it attracts attention?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needs spirit stones urgently for third-grade puppet materials. The risk of exposure is lower than the risk of stalling his combat power growth.
